## OTITIS MEDIA
Streptococcus pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenza, and Moraxella catarrhalis are
the most common bacteria to cause otitis media.
## Preferred treatment
Patient has NOT received antibiotics in the prior month
[Amoxicillin 1000 mg PO q8h for 10 days ($) [R]](psjzid-amoxicillin-1000mg-po-q8h)
Patient has received antibiotics in the prior month
[Amoxicillin/clavulanate 875-125 mg PO q12h for 10 days ($) [R]](psjzid-amox-clav-875-125mg-po-q12h)
## Alternatives
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orzid2-gmenu-abx-beta-lactam-allergy-assesment)
[Cefdinir 300 mg PO q12h for 10 days ($) [R]](psjzid-cefdinir-300mg-po-q12h)
< OR >
[Cefpodoxime 200 mg PO BID for 10 days ($$) [R]](psjzid-cefpodoxime-100mg-po-q12h)
